edits.find: CT before LP only if: papilledema, focal deficit, seizure, immunocompromise, depressed consciousness, age >60 — an open fontanelle in an infant generally removes the requirement, since it acts as a pop-off valve. Never delay antibiotics — draw cultures and treat. Empiric: vancomycin + ceftriaxone (+ ampicillin for Listeria); neonates get cefotaxime, not ceftriaxone (biliary sludging, bilirubin displacement). Dexamethasone before or with the first antibiotic dose — it blunts the cytokine burst from bacterial lysis.

Empiric therapy is vancomycin + ceftriaxone (+ ampicillin for Listeria). Neonates get cefotaxime, not ceftriaxone (biliary sludging, bilirubin displacement). Dexamethasone before or with the first antibiotic dose blunts the cytokine burst from bacterial lysis.
